name: ripple-button

frames.best_why: The pale ripple has spread across most of the button while the white label stays crisp.

tagline: A pale circle blooms from the exact click point and washes across the button.
summary: A dark outlined button that answers each press with a circle growing out of the spot the pointer hit. The pale disc swells to twice its size and fades away.
appearance: One rounded rectangle on black, drawn with a thin grey border, a near-black fill and bold white text. On a press a pale blue-grey disc appears beneath the label, widening past the button's inside edges before it thins.
behaviour: Every click drops a circle centred on the pointer; over about six hundred milliseconds it scales from nothing to double size while fading to transparent, then disappears. Between presses the button does not move.
search_phrases: click makes a circle spread across the button
button that reacts where you tap
subtle feedback for clicking a button
send invite button with a splash
use_when: A press needs clear visual confirmation without shifting the layout, especially on touch screens.
avoid_when: Buttons that already animate their state, or tiny buttons where the disc has no room to read.
customise: The label is children and a click handler can be passed through; ripple colour and duration are props, while border, padding and type come from className and the base classes.
weight_why: One absolutely positioned span per press with a single keyframe, removed after it runs.

a11y.note: Keyboard activation drops the ripple at the top-left corner since there are no pointer coordinates; reduced motion is ignored.

issues: The ripple is clipped inside the button, so it reads as a wash of fill rather than a wave leaving the edge.
polish_why: A competent, standard material-style ripple, but the plain bordered button adds little.
